description: Unit test class for ImmutablePayload and its builder, testing immutability, JSON serialization/deserialization, and correctness of getters in the context of the org.eclipse.ditto.protocoladapter package.

classes.name: ImmutablePayloadTest
classes.description: Contains unit tests for the ImmutablePayload class, verifying equality, immutability, getters, JSON serialization, and builder correctness.

methods.name: setUpClass
methods.description: Initializes static test data before any test runs, setting up a known JsonObject, JsonRepresentation, and ImmutablePayload instance.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies that the ImmutablePayload class correctly implements hashCode and equals methods using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that ImmutablePayload and related classes are immutable using MutabilityDetector.

methods.name: gettersReturnExpected
methods.description: Tests that all getter methods of a known payload return expected values.

methods.name: toJsonWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that the toJson method of ImmutablePayload produces the expected JsonObject.

methods.name: fromJsonWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Tests that creating an ImmutablePayload from its JSON representation yields an equivalent object.

methods.name: toBuilderMaintainsIdentity
methods.description: Ensures that converting an ImmutablePayload to a builder and building again maintains object equality.
